description: No direct DB facade calls in React frontend
what: Database facade or Eloquent reference detected in resources/js frontend files.
why: Frontend React components must interact exclusively via Inertia routes or API endpoints.
fix: Remove the database reference from the JS file and expose required data through Inertia props in app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php or controller response.

description: No raw debug statements (dd, dump, var_dump) in app code
what: Debug statement (dd, dump, var_dump) committed in backend PHP code.
why: Debug statements abort execution and must never reach production or test environments.
fix: Remove dd(), dump(), or var_dump() from the affected PHP file in app/ before committing.

description: No hardcoded secrets or API tokens in JavaScript bundles
what: Hardcoded live API secret found in client-side JavaScript code.
why: Client-side code is public and expose private payment gateway keys.
fix: Move secret keys to .env and access them exclusively via backend Laravel config in config/services.php.

description: Enforce constant-time hash_equals on cryptographic webhook signatures
what: Webhook signature verification using non-constant-time operator !== instead of hash_equals().
why: Non-constant-time string comparison on signatures creates timing side-channel vulnerabilities.
fix: Use hash_equals($expectedSignature, (string) $signatureKey) for all cryptographic comparisons.
